name: Bodyguard
text: Select a friendly `HERO` within 1" of this fighter. Until the end of the battle round, that Hero cannot be targeted while they are within 1" of this fighter.

name: Endure
text: A fighter can make this reaction after they are targeted by an attack action but before the hit rolls are made. Subtract 1 from the damage points allocated by each hit and critical hit (to a minimum of 1) from that attack action.

name: Eagle Eyes
text: When making an attack action using a bow, crossbow or handgun, this fighter may ignore the maximum range of the weapon, but if they do, they must reduce their Shoot characteristic by 1.

name: Indomitable
text: Each time this fighter is activated, you can remove D3 damage points allocated to them.

name: Maintain Momentum
text: A fighter can only use this ability if an enemy fighter has been taken down by an attack action made by them this activation. This fighter makes a bonus move action or a bonus attack action.

name: Nine Lives
text: When rolling for injuries, this fighter can re-roll a result of 11-12. In addition, there is no limit to the amount of permanent injuries this fighter may have.

name: Oppressor
text: Once per battle round, when an enemy fighter makes the 'Retreat' action, this fighter can make the 'Cut Them Down' reaction without having to forfeit an action to do so.

name: Patient Hunter
text: When an enemy fighter ends a move action while visible to this fighter, this fighter can target that enemy fighter with a free ranged attack action.

name: Rapid Reload
text: At the end of the battleround, you may reload one of this fighter's weapons with the Reload special rule.

name: Reckless Shot
text: For this fighter's next ranged attack action, it may target enemy fighters within 1" of friendly fighters.

name: Shield Bash
text: This ability requires the fighter being equipped with a shield. Select an enemy fighter within 1" of this fighter. That fighter makes a free retreat action directly away from this fighter. If it cannot move away from this fighter, allocate (X/2) damage points to that fighter instead.

name: Shield Wall
text: This ability requires the fighter being equipped with a shield. Until the end of the battle round, add (X/2) to the Defense characteristic of all friendly fighters within 1" of this fighter when targeted by ranged attack actions.

name: Staggering Blows
text: A fighter can use this ability after allocating damage points to an enemy fighter with a melee attack action. That enemy fighter cannot use reactions for the rest of the battle round. In addition, if the melee attack action allocated damage points from a critical hit, the target cannot use abilities for the rest of the battle round.

name: Surgical Precision
text: Select a ranged weapon type. When making attack actions with weapons of that type, increase the Critical Damage characteristic by 1.

name: Tough
text: Each time an attack action scores any critical hits on this fighter, 1 of those critical hits becomes a hit instead.

name: Trick Shot
text: When this fighter makes a ranged attack action, the target does not count as being in cover.

name: Weapon Master
text: Select a melee weapon type. When making attack actions with weapons of that type, increase the critical damage characteristic by 1.
